description: A burly older man with shaggy grey hair and a short grey beard stands behind a wooden railing, shown from the hips up, facing the viewer at the party's eye level. He wears a black sleeveless jerkin studded with silver rivets and a wide grey belt with a gold buckle. His left arm (on the right of the picture) is bent with the fist on his hip, and his right arm is raised high, gripping a long wooden stick or staff that slants off past the top left corner. The background is a flat, bright magenta. The mood is gruff and agitated, as if he is scolding or shouting. Frame 1: the stick is raised with his mouth closed. Frame 2: the stick jerks and his face changes, briefly. Frame 3: his mouth opens to shout. Frame 4: the stick shakes again, briefly. Frame 5: his mouth moves as he keeps talking. Frame 6: the stick settles back, held a moment. The loop reads as a man angrily waving his stick while he rants.
title: Grey-haired man shaking a stick
